Import existing runs into the ledger

pk_import_legacy.Rd

Imports fits that were saved as <run>.rds (and optionally the generated model code <run>.txt) by script-based workflows into the ledger of the current project. The parent of each run is taken from run history tables that have the columns Run and Reference (for example the development tables written by a numbered-script workflow). Imported runs get the stage "legacy", the decision "pending", and no run key (they are never returned by the cache). The model code, if available, is stored as a custom specification so that the run can be used as a parent.

Usage

pk_import_legacy(
  models_dir,
  history = character(),
  pattern = "^run[0-9A-Za-z_]+\\.rds$",
  quiet = FALSE,
  proj = NULL
)

Arguments

models_dir

Folder with <run>.rds files.

history

Character vector of csv files with the columns Run and Reference (and optionally Description).

pattern

Regular expression for the file names to import.

quiet

Suppress progress messages?

proj

A pk_project object. Defaults to the current project.

Value

The imported run ids (invisibly).

Details

The source folder is only read, never modified.
